name: Ain't Nobody Got Time For That
aka: Ain't Nobody Got Time For Dat
look: A still from a local TV news interview. A Black woman in a patterned orange and white headscarf and a colorful tank top talks to the camera with an incredulous, animated expression, in front of a brick apartment building, with a channel 4 logo in the corner.
use: A flat refusal to deal with something annoying or tedious. The caption names the hassle, and the reaction says you simply don't have the time or patience for it.
slots: ain't nobody got time for that (bottom)
examples: A 45-minute hold time with customer service

origin: A 2012 local TV news interview in Oklahoma City with a woman describing how she escaped an apartment fire.
